patch.summary: AdCreative.ai cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: AdCreative.ai pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: AdCreative.ai cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price AdCreative.ai against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 7-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, image generation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Paid media teams and agencies generating ad variants at scale requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.body: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma

items.title: Cost trap 2

items.title: Cost trap 3
